facts.title: Fancy Components
facts.description: Ready to use, fancy React components to make the web fun again. Free & Open Source.

research.name: Fancy Components
research.note: React and Motion collection that recreates playful effects seen on award-winning sites, from variable-font hovers to physics.
unverified: The components' source is public in the GitHub repository danielpetho/fancy, linked from the site; that repository has not yet been researched in place of this site.
The effects other than the homepage cards were seen as names in the docs sidebar, not watched running.
